title: IsletCalc: Calculators for Insulin and Glucagon Release Indices
description: Facilitates the calculation of validated pancreatic islet hormone-release indices from fasting and oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) measurements. Provides beta-cell insulin release indices (including HOMA-beta, corrected insulin response, Stumvoll first-phase index, BIGTT-AIR, and disposition indices), alongside alpha-cell glucagon release and glucagon resistance indices.
